paragraphs_en: The Flood Response Working Group has successfully finalised its initial Terms of Reference with the publication of the Flood Response – Capacity Building – Reference Note. This document is accessible via the ‘ Technical Reference Library ’ tab . The Working Group is now dedicated to formulating its 2025–2027 Terms of Reference to advance further knowledge-sharing initiatives. Heartfelt congratulations to all members of the Flood Response Working Group and contributors to this reference note for their exemplary efforts.
paragraphs_zh: 洪水响应工作组已通过发布《洪水响应——能力建设——参考说明》成功敲定了其初始职权范围。该文件可通过“技术参考图书馆”选项卡访问。工作组目前正致力于制定其2025—2027年职权范围，以推进进一步的知识共享举措。衷心祝贺洪水响应工作组全体成员及本参考说明的贡献者，感谢他们的卓越努力。
